headline: ACC Limited: Shareholders meeting

detail: Shareholders meeting - ACC Limited has informed the Exchange regarding outcome and proceedings of NCLT Convened General Meeting held on September 29, 2026. Further, the company has submitted the Exchange a copy of Scrutinizers report along with voting results.
